def VTask.strongDownwardInduction : {α : Type u_1} -> {p : Multiset α → Sort u_3} -> {n : ℕ} -> (H : (t₁ : Multiset α) → ({t₂ : Multiset α} → t₂.card ≤ n → t₁ < t₂ → p t₂) → t₁.card ≤ n → p t₁) -> (s : Multiset α) -> s.card ≤ n → p s :=
  @fun α p n H s h => by
    classical
    -- Use the well-founded recursion principle to define the induction
    have h₁ : ∀ (s : Multiset α), s.card ≤ n → p s := by
      intro s hs
      -- Use the fact that the multiset order is well-founded to perform strong induction
      have h₂ : ∀ (s : Multiset α), s.card ≤ n → p s := by
        intro s hs
        -- Use the well-founded recursion principle to define the induction
        apply WellFounded.fix (IsWellFounded.wf : WellFounded (· < · : Multiset α → Multiset α → Prop))
          (fun s ih => H s (fun {t₂} ht₂ ht => ih t₂ ht₂ ht) hs)
          s
      exact h₂ s hs
    exact h₁ s h
